description: Screens the compiler refuses, each with the message it gives

examples.intent: A field the event does not have

input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96" />
  <qs:on event="service-crash">
    <qs:say text="{svc} stopped" />
  </qs:on>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: {svc} could never be filled in: service-crash has unit, service, exit_code, title, body and severity.

input.natural_language: Show the last notice's title as a fixed text
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96">
    <qs:text value="{title}" x="0" y="0" />
  </qs:scene>
</q:application>

expected_error.message: goes in a <qs:on>, not in the scene

examples.why_invalid: The scene is fixed; a {field} is filled in from an event.
examples.correction: Use <qs:say text="{title}"/> in a <qs:on>, or the <qs:notices>.

examples.intent: A target no sprite is named

input.natural_language: Reset apache's cell when an action is done
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:sheet name="cell" src="art/cells.png" tile="24" />
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96">
    <qs:sprite name="nginx" sheet="cell" x="0" y="0" />
  </qs:scene>
  <qs:on event="done">
    <qs:frame target="apache" frame="0" />
  </qs:on>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: A literal target must be a sprite of the scene.
examples.correction: Name a sprite apache, or write target="{service}".

examples.intent: A sprite of a sheet that is not there

input.natural_language: A sprite of a sheet the file never declares
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96">
    <qs:sprite sheet="ghost" x="0" y="0" />
  </qs:scene>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: Every sprite is a frame of a declared sheet.

examples.intent: A frame the sheet does not have

input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:sheet name="cell" src="art/cells.png" tile="24" />
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96">
    <qs:sprite sheet="cell" frame="9" x="0" y="0" />
  </qs:scene>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: The compiler counts the sheet's frames from the PNG.

input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:sheet name="cell" src="art/cells.png" tile="24">
    <qs:animation name="smoke" frames="2,3" />
  </qs:sheet>
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96">
    <qs:sprite name="nginx" sheet="cell" x="0" y="0" />
  </qs:scene>
  <qs:on event="done">
    <qs:animate target="nginx" name="run" />
  </qs:on>
</q:application>

expected_error.message: has no animation of that name

examples.why_invalid: An animation belongs to a sheet; the target's sheet has only smoke.

input.natural_language: Rain over the scene with no qs:particles
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96">
    <qs:emitter particles="rain" x="0" y="0" width="128" />
  </qs:scene>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: An effect is declared once, then used.

input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96" />
  <q:set name="crashes" value="0" />
</q:application>

expected_error.message: not part of the screen language

examples.why_invalid: A screen file is declarations: nothing to compute.
examples.correction: Leave the counting to the Hive; the screen shows.

input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96" />
  <qs:on event="done">print("done")<qs:say text="done" /></qs:on>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: Text inside a tag is refused.

input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96" />
  <qs:on event="service-crash"><qs:say text="a" /></qs:on>
  <qs:on event="service-crash"><qs:say text="b" /></qs:on>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: The order of an event's actions lives in one place.

input.natural_language: Only rules, nothing to draw on

examples.why_invalid: The scene is what the daemon draws; a screen without one is nothing.

examples.intent: An event that is not one

input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="screen">
  <qs:scene width="128" height="96" />
  <qs:on event="reboot"><qs:say text="bye" /></qs:on>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: The events are the Hive's: the schema lists them.
examples.correction: Use one of the listed events.
